tldr: Sun in the 10th house routes identity and life force through public contribution.
body: With the Sun in the 10th house, identity, vitality, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center move through career, public role, reputation, authority, and legacy. This makes how you become visible, take responsibility, and build a life that can be recognized a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose. Left unconscious, it can become over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through public contribution.
challenge: over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth concentrated in public contribution.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
